capability_tiers.label: Everyday roadmap
capability_tiers.entry_rule: Available after setup without creating optional delivery state.

capability_tiers.label: One bounded delivery
capability_tiers.entry_rule: Starts only after a person reviews the exact work and limits and confirms the separate start.

capability_tiers.label: Optional delivery program
capability_tiers.entry_rule: Starts only after a person deliberately configures it, reviews the exact work and limits, and confirms the separate start.

operator_questions.text: Who is doing and reviewing it?
What may the delivery still change or spend?

screen_slices.title: Decisions, blockers, permission, cost, and control

journeys.title: Healthy first arrival
journeys.user_question: Is this repository ready, and what useful work can I do now?

visible_facts.statement: One ordinary roadmap story is ready to continue.
The repository is ready and earlier completed work remains visible.
Open the current story; optional coordination is not required.

bounded_actions.label: Open current work
bounded_actions.effect: Opens the current story without changing repository or delivery state.

bounded_actions.label: Check readiness
bounded_actions.effect: Reads current readiness facts and makes no change.

bounded_actions.label: Leave for now
bounded_actions.effect: Leaves every repository and delivery fact unchanged.

success_outcome.summary: The person can identify current work and continue without optional setup.

refusal_recovery.summary: If readiness cannot be established, show the affected check and do not suggest that work may start.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No repository or delivery state changes.

journeys.title: Deliberate delivery choice
journeys.user_question: How much coordination do I want for this delivery?

visible_facts.statement: Ordinary roadmap work remains available with no optional setup.
One bounded delivery and an optional program each require a separate reviewed start.
Stay with the roadmap, review one bounded delivery, or review an optional program.

bounded_actions.label: Continue with the roadmap
bounded_actions.effect: Returns to ordinary work and creates no optional delivery state.

bounded_actions.label: Confirm one bounded delivery
bounded_actions.effect: Starts only the reviewed work with the reviewed limits; it does not enable an optional program.

bounded_actions.label: Confirm the optional program
bounded_actions.effect: Starts only the reviewed optional program with the reviewed scope and limits.

success_outcome.summary: The selected tier is explicit, and any higher tier starts only after its own confirmation.

refusal_recovery.summary: If a start is stale or incomplete, nothing starts and the person may return to ordinary work.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: Ordinary roadmap work and every unselected tier remain unchanged.

journeys.title: Delivery-plan setup
journeys.user_question: What will be delivered, in what order, and where should work stop?

visible_facts.statement: The draft names the work, sequence, review points, repair paths, and stop conditions.
Saving the draft starts no work and provides no permission to act.
Review the readable plan, then save it or leave it unchanged.

bounded_actions.label: Save reviewed draft
bounded_actions.effect: Writes only the reviewed delivery-plan document and starts no work.

bounded_actions.label: Discard unsaved changes
bounded_actions.effect: Leaves the saved delivery plan and every runtime fact unchanged.

bounded_actions.label: Review plan summary
bounded_actions.effect: Shows the plan summary and makes no change.

success_outcome.summary: The saved draft preserves the reviewed plan and still starts nothing.

next_step.label: Set up the team and review

refusal_recovery.summary: If validation or freshness fails, identify the affected delivery decision and keep the saved document unchanged.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No draft, permission, work, or roadmap state changes.

journeys.title: Team and review setup
journeys.user_question: Who will do, review, and decide on this work?

visible_facts.statement: The summary names who does each kind of work and who reviews it independently.
The summary names required reviews, contested decisions, and escalation paths.
Any incompatible assignment identifies the exact roles and a corrective choice.

bounded_actions.label: Save reviewed team
bounded_actions.effect: Writes only the reviewed team document and starts no work.

bounded_actions.label: Discard unsaved changes
bounded_actions.effect: Leaves the saved team and every runtime fact unchanged.

bounded_actions.label: Review responsibilities
bounded_actions.effect: Shows responsibilities and separation facts and makes no change.

success_outcome.summary: The saved team makes responsibility, independent review, and decision ownership understandable.

refusal_recovery.summary: If responsibility or independence is invalid, name the conflict and keep the saved team unchanged.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No team, permission, work, or roadmap state changes.

journeys.title: Delivery preflight
journeys.user_question: Is this delivery ready to start, and what exactly may it do?

visible_facts.statement: The reviewed work, order, checks, and stop conditions are valid.
The people or agents responsible for work and review are named.
The exact allowed effects, time, work, and cost limits are shown before start.
Confirm this reviewed delivery or return to the plan.

bounded_actions.label: Confirm this delivery
bounded_actions.effect: Starts only the reviewed work under the reviewed limits and does not continue automatically.

bounded_actions.label: Return to the plan
bounded_actions.effect: Returns to setup and starts nothing.

bounded_actions.label: Leave for now
bounded_actions.effect: Leaves the plan, repository, and delivery state unchanged.

success_outcome.summary: The exact reviewed delivery starts once and remains bounded by the displayed limits.

refusal_recovery.summary: If readiness, freshness, or permission fails, nothing starts and the affected fact is named.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No work, process, permission, or roadmap state is created or changed.

journeys.title: Live delivery progress
journeys.user_question: What is happening now, what passed, and what happens next?

visible_facts.statement: Current, waiting, completed, and blocked work are visibly distinct.
Completed checks and reviews state what they establish.
Consumed and remaining work, time, and cost are shown with their limits.
One canonical next step explains whether to advance, wait, decide, repair, or stop.

bounded_actions.label: Refresh progress
bounded_actions.effect: Reloads the canonical delivery state and starts no work.

bounded_actions.label: Advance one step
bounded_actions.effect: Performs at most the one reviewed next delivery step.

bounded_actions.label: Pause delivery
bounded_actions.effect: Stops new work from starting while preserving completed work and current state.

success_outcome.summary: The display explains progress and the reviewed next step advances at most once.

refusal_recovery.summary: If the next step is stale or unavailable, show what changed and start no replacement step.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No unreviewed work starts and completed work remains recorded.

journeys.title: Failed review and repair
journeys.user_question: What failed, what can repair it, and what remains safe?

visible_facts.statement: The failed check states what it tested and what did not pass.
Affected work and the available repair path are named.
Retry the bounded repair, pause safely, or inspect the failure.

bounded_actions.label: Review the failed check
bounded_actions.effect: Opens the failure explanation and makes no change.

bounded_actions.label: Retry the bounded repair
bounded_actions.effect: Starts only the reviewed repair attempt under the remaining limits.

bounded_actions.label: Pause delivery
bounded_actions.effect: Starts no further work and preserves the failure and completed work.

success_outcome.summary: Only the reviewed repair runs, and the failed check must pass before work continues.

refusal_recovery.summary: If repair is unavailable or its facts changed, start nothing and preserve the failure for review.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No replacement work starts and the prior failure remains visible.

journeys.title: Blocked human decision
journeys.user_question: Who must decide, which choices are valid, and what follows each choice?

visible_facts.statement: The affected work and reason it cannot continue are named.
The responsible person, closed choices, and effect of each choice are shown.
Respond with one valid choice or leave the decision pending.

bounded_actions.label: Approve this request
bounded_actions.effect: Applies approval only to the exact outstanding request and then rechecks what may proceed.

bounded_actions.label: Reject this request
bounded_actions.effect: Applies rejection only to the exact outstanding request and keeps affected work stopped.

bounded_actions.label: Decide later
bounded_actions.effect: Leaves the request pending and starts no affected work.

success_outcome.summary: One exact decision is recorded and the canonical next step is recalculated.

refusal_recovery.summary: If the request is stale, mismatched, already answered, or unavailable, refuse without guessing another response.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: The outstanding decision and affected work remain unchanged.

journeys.title: Remaining permission and cost
journeys.user_question: What may this delivery still change or spend?

visible_facts.statement: Allowed effects, scope, expiry, stop conditions, and forbidden effects are stated.
Each limit distinguishes total, used, remaining, unknown, and not applicable.
Continue once, pause, or permanently stop after reviewing the current limits.

bounded_actions.label: Review remaining limits
bounded_actions.effect: Shows current permission and cost facts and makes no change.

bounded_actions.label: Pause the program
bounded_actions.effect: Stops new work from starting while preserving completed work and current limits.

bounded_actions.label: Permanently stop the program
bounded_actions.effect: Permanently prevents new program work while preserving completed work and exact history.

success_outcome.summary: The person can distinguish what remains allowed, consumed, and forbidden before acting.

refusal_recovery.summary: If limit facts are stale or unavailable, do not act and do not estimate authority.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No work starts and no permission or cost value changes.

journeys.title: Stop and revoke
journeys.user_question: How do I pause safely or permanently stop this delivery?

visible_facts.statement: Active and completed work are shown before a stop choice.
Pause is reversible; permanent stop prevents future program work.
Confirm one stop choice or return without changing delivery state.

bounded_actions.label: Pause the program
bounded_actions.effect: Stops new program work until a separately reviewed resume.

bounded_actions.label: Permanently stop the program
bounded_actions.effect: Permanently prevents new program work while preserving completed work and exact history.

bounded_actions.label: Return without stopping
bounded_actions.effect: Leaves current delivery state unchanged.

success_outcome.summary: The selected stop takes effect once and its consequence is visible.

refusal_recovery.summary: If the stop choice is stale or mismatched, do not apply a different stop and show the current state.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No stop or resume is applied.

journeys.title: Crash recovery
journeys.user_question: After interruption, what completed, what may resume, and what happens next?

visible_facts.statement: Completed and in-progress effects are reconstructed from canonical state.
Any uncertain or incomplete boundary remains stopped for review.
Resume uses only still-valid permission and remaining limits.
Reload state, then resume deliberately or permanently stop.

bounded_actions.label: Reload delivery state
bounded_actions.effect: Reconstructs the canonical view and starts no work.

bounded_actions.label: Resume reviewed work
bounded_actions.effect: Allows only still-valid reviewed work to continue after state is rechecked.

bounded_actions.label: Permanently stop delivery
bounded_actions.effect: Prevents future work while preserving completed and uncertain state for inspection.

success_outcome.summary: Recovered state distinguishes completed, incomplete, and eligible work before anything resumes.

refusal_recovery.summary: If recovery cannot prove current state or permission, keep work stopped and expose the exact record.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No uncertain work is repeated and no new work starts.

journeys.title: Reviewed completion
journeys.user_question: What finished, what passed, and is there more work?

visible_facts.statement: The completed delivery and any remaining scoped work are named.
Passed checks, independent review, dissent, and final outcome remain distinct.
Completion states whether the work item or the whole delivery is finished.
Open the next work item or stop because the delivery is complete.

bounded_actions.label: Review what passed
bounded_actions.effect: Shows the review outcome and makes no change.

bounded_actions.label: Open next work
bounded_actions.effect: Opens the next eligible work item and starts nothing.

bounded_actions.label: Finish here
bounded_actions.effect: Leaves completed work and delivery state unchanged.

success_outcome.summary: The person can tell what passed, what completed, and whether any work remains.

refusal_recovery.summary: If completion cannot be established, do not claim success and identify the missing review or work fact.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No work or completion state changes.

journeys.title: Technical inspection
journeys.user_question: How can I inspect the exact record without losing the delivery summary?

visible_facts.statement: The ordinary summary remains the default view and names its canonical sources.
The exact permission, limits, identities, events, and configuration are one explicit view away.
Open exact details, copy what is needed, then return to the delivery summary.

bounded_actions.label: Open Technical details
bounded_actions.effect: Opens the exact source record and makes no change.

bounded_actions.label: Copy exact details
bounded_actions.effect: Copies selected exact data and makes no delivery change.

bounded_actions.label: Back to delivery summary
bounded_actions.effect: Returns to the ordinary summary and makes no change.

success_outcome.summary: Exact data is inspectable and the person can return to the same ordinary task context.

refusal_recovery.summary: If exact data cannot be loaded, say which source is unavailable and keep the ordinary summary usable.
refusal_recovery.unchanged: No delivery state changes and no technical value is guessed.
